title: Print Navbar Chapter Chip
description: Navbar top right should show the current chapter name inside the chip. Currently empty in zwischenbericht and other templates.
summary: Navbar top-right chip now shows the current chapter or section title via `\semio@chrome@heading@track` hooked into heading `titleformat`. Chapters and parts always update the chip; sections update it only when no chapter is active, so zwischenbericht-style documents show section names like Ergebnisse.
